findings.issue: `action` is given `@[expose]` only so the new file can `rw [HopfAlgebra.PointRepresentation.action, …]` across the module boundary (TensorProduct.lean:98 in `action_trivial`, TensorProduct.lean:273 in `action_tensor`). summary: New public surface (trivial, tensor, and their characteristic lemmas) is minimal, well-annotated, and complete. But the PR adds @[expose] to PointRepresentation.action solely so downstream files can unfold it via rw, instead of providing the missing restatement lemma.
